seed_alias: Initial semantic packet of a three-dimensional incompressible flow

same_semantics: One incompressible-fluid identity is preserved at every finite time
With zero forcing, every momentum provenance comes from the given initial packet
Changes of coordinate location or presentation scale do not alter provenance identity

different_semantics: Velocity differences in position, direction, and scale
The distinct roles of transport rearrangement, viscous elimination, and pressure-constraint closure
Every new difference must be explicitly registered and may not exist silently

complete_semantics: A complete flow state consists of the initial provenance, co-provenance transport, viscous difference elimination, and incompressibility pressure closure
Pressure has no independent provenance identity and is not a third source
Future differences may arise only from registered provenance relations through explicit core routes

value_information: No silent creation of a third source
No erasure of a registered provenance difference
No rewriting of potentially unbounded instances as a completed infinity inside one object
Preserve incompressible identity and bidirectional replay

P.input: A smooth divergence-free initial velocity packet u0, viscosity nu>0, and forcing f=0
P.output: A smooth divergence-free provenance-replayable flow packet u(T) at every finite time T

same_semantics: Every finite-time output remains registered to the same initial fluid provenance
Input and output round-trip through one provenance digest

different_semantics: The same provenance is explicitly differentiated into relocation, velocity, and constraint differences
Every difference retains its provenance identifier

complete_semantics: Transport only rearranges co-provenance differences, viscosity endogenously eliminates differences, and pressure only closes incompressibility
The three roles cover every registered difference and generate no hidden fourth channel

value_information: Complete semantics forbids a third source, provenance erasure, and completed infinity
An eliminated provenance obligation may not return as a same-level unresolved difference

target_part.input: A complete smooth flow packet at an arbitrary finite time
target_part.output: A complete smooth flow packet continuable to the next finite time

complete_semantics: For every finite T, finitely instantiated explicit core routes form a replayable flow normal form
No finite time contains an unregistered singular provenance obligation

output_alias: Three-dimensional Navier-Stokes co-provenance transport-viscosity smooth normal form
